subject: Re: Redwood trial & procurement path - PO vs card
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@avasolutions.com>, procurement@avasolutions.com
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial & procurement path - PO vs card

Hi Jane / Procurements team,

Thanks again for taking the call today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have alignment.

Recap from our discovery:
- Ava Solutions is interested in a 3-month reserved capacity trial for a product-recommendation flow (low latency, ~3M tokens/month).
- Primary procurement constraint: AP prefers Purchase Orders (POs) for commitments above $5k/month; credit card payments are allowed for ad-hoc / self-serve purchases under that threshold.
- Vendor onboarding: you mentioned a standard vendor form, W9, and vendor profile (ACH details) as part of onboarding.

Next steps we suggest:
1) I attached a preliminary sales quote for the 3-month reserved capacity (Redwood_Sales_Quote_20260310.pdf). This is draft and we can adjust sizing.
2) If you want to proceed via PO/Net30, we can route this through our finance team — please confirm the exact vendor packet we should complete (it sounded like Vendor_Onboarding_Form_AVA.xlsx).
3) If the AP path needs the transaction to go through a marketplace (AWS/GCP) to simplify vendor onboarding, flag that now — we can discuss marketplace options.

Can you confirm: 1) whether you will submit a PO for the pilot, 2) the name/email of the person who owns vendor onboarding, and 3) any specific PO language or billing contact we should include on the invoice?

If helpful, I can loop in our finance lead (David) and legal/ops (Rishi) to speed the vendor onboarding.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(Attachment: Redwood_Sales_Quote_20260310.pdf - Sales quote, 58KB)

From: Jane Smith <jane.smith@avasolutions.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@avasolutions.com
Date: Tue, 10 Mar 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial & procurement path - PO vs card

Marissa,

Thanks for the recap and the quote — appreciated. A few clarifying points from AP so we can move this internally: 

- Our AP policy requires a signed PO for any vendor commitments > $5,000. For pilots under $5k we can use a corporate card. The quoted pilot looks like it will be above that threshold so PO is likely.
- Vendor onboarding: we will need a completed vendor form (I'll attach our template below), W9, and a copy of your company registration. Our onboarding team will also need an invoice sample that includes PO number and Net30 terms.
- Marketplace: if the purchase can be processed via the AWS Marketplace or GCP Marketplace that sometimes speeds procurement because it avoids separate vendor onboarding. Is Redwood listed on those marketplaces?

Can you send: 1) your vendor packet (completed), 2) W9 and company reg, 3) a sample invoice that we can show AP? Once we have those items, I can open the PO and estimate a timeline — typical turnaround is 5-10 business days after packet completion.

Thanks,
Jane
Senior Procurement Manager
Ava Solutions
(jane.smith@avasolutions.com)

(Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_AVA.xlsx - Vendor form, 24KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jane Smith <jane.smith@avasolutions.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial & procurement path - PO vs card

Hi Jane — thanks for the details.

Quick answers and what I can send right away:
- Marketplace presence: Redwood is currently listed on the AWS Marketplace for select enterprise customers (we're working to expand availability). I'll confirm whether this purchase can be routed via AWS Marketplace for Ava. If marketplace is preferred, that often removes the need for separate vendor onboarding.
- PO / Net30: We do accept PO/Net30 terms for enterprise purchases. For pilots and reserved capacity we can do a standard PO with Net30. Our finance/legal team signs the vendor agreement and issues an invoice with the PO number.
- Docs I can attach now: completed vendor onboarding packet (Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Packet_20260311.zip), W9, company registration PDF, and a sample invoice template that shows PO and Net30.

I've attached the onboarding packet and the quote I sent earlier. David and Rishi are looped in to help with any finance/legal questions so we can get your packet completed this week if you like.

Proposed next steps:
1) You send back the completed Vendor_Onboarding_Form_AVA.xlsx (or confirm which fields you need pre-filled).
2) Once we have that, David will coordinate signatures and return the completed packet + W9 + invoice sample.
3) You open the PO; once we receive the PO number we'll issue the invoice and start provisioning the reserved capacity.

If you prefer, we can also process an initial month on card to speed the trial while onboarding the vendor for the PO for the remaining term.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the attachments now.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
(Attachment: Redwood_Vendor_Onboarding_Packet_20260311.zip - onboarding packet, 120KB)
(Attachment: Redwood_Sample_Invoice_PO_Net30.pdf - sample invoice, 12KB)

From: Jane Smith <jane.smith@avasolutions.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@avasolutions.com
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood trial & procurement path - PO vs card

Marissa,

That sounds good — thanks for the quick turnaround. I confirmed with the onboarding team: please complete the Vendor_Onboarding_Form_AVA.xlsx and include W9 + company reg in a single packet. Once we have that, I'll create the PO (targeting Net30).

We will aim to have the PO submitted by end of day 2026-03-19. For now I'll plan to process the first month's payment on card (to avoid delays) unless you prefer otherwise. Please confirm if that approach works for Redwood.

Also, please include billing contact: billing@avasolutions.com and PO language: "Ava Solutions purchase order — payment terms Net30; billing to billing@avasolutions.com; ship-to N/A (service)."

If you can return the completed packet by EOD 2026-03-15, that gives procurement enough time to create the PO.

Thanks,
Jane
Senior Procurement Manager
Ava Solutions
(Attachment: Vendor_Onboarding_Form_AVA.xlsx - completed template expected)
